name: ours-nextjs-example
description: This repository provides a working example of integrating the Ours analytics platform with a Next.js application. It demonstrates how to set up the Ours tracking script, track page views, and log custom events like button clicks or form submissions—all while maintaining privacy and HIPAA compliance.

paragraphs: This repo is a working reference for integrating the Ours Privacy CDP (Customer Data Platform) and CMP (Consent Management Platform) into a Next.js application. Browse the code to see how each product is installed, initialized, and used.
In Next.js, a layout is a component that wraps every page in its directory. Layouts are the right place to load analytics and consent scripts because:
This project has four product-specific nested layouts:
features: They run once — the layout mounts when a visitor enters that section of your site. Scripts initialize once and persist across page navigations.
They wrap all child pages — every page inside the layout folder automatically gets the scripts without repeating code.
They compose — the root layout provides global things (nav, fonts, CSS), and nested layouts add product-specific scripts on top.
